def design(feats):
    X = np.asarray(feats.x, float); y = np.asarray(feats.y, float); n, p = X.shape
    ids = list(feats.ids); labs = sorted(set(feats.stratum))
    S = np.array([[s == l for l in labs[1:]] for s in feats.stratum], float).reshape(n, -1)
    base = np.column_stack([np.ones(n), S])
    def ll(Z):
        A = np.column_stack([base, Z]) if Z is not None and len(Z) else base
        b = np.zeros(A.shape[1])
        for _ in range(30):
            e = np.clip(A @ b, -30, 30); m = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-e)); w = m * (1 - m) + 1e-9
            H = A.T @ (A * w[:, None]) + 1e-6 * np.eye(A.shape[1])
            st = np.linalg.solve(H, A.T @ (y - m)); b += st
            if np.max(np.abs(st)) < 1e-8: break
        m = np.clip(1 / (1 + np.exp(-np.clip(A @ b, -30, 30))), 1e-12, 1 - 1e-12)
        return float(np.sum(y * np.log(m) + (1 - y) * np.log(1 - m)))
    def cols(sel, extra=()):
        z = [Xe[:, j] for j in sel] + [Xe[:, a] * Xe[:, b] for a, b in extra]
        return np.column_stack(z) if z else None
    R = np.nan_to_num(np.corrcoef(X.T)); np.fill_diagonal(R, 0)
    M = (np.abs(R) >= 0.75) | np.eye(p, dtype=bool)
    for _ in range(6): M = M @ M
    comps = sorted([list(c) for c in {tuple(np.nonzero(r)[0].tolist()) for r in M} if len(c) >= 3], key=len, reverse=True)
    l0 = ll(None); mod, load, smod, solo = [], {}, None, None
    for c in comps:
        w = np.linalg.eigh(np.corrcoef(X[:, c].T))[1][:, -1]; s = X[:, c] @ w
        cj = np.array([np.corrcoef(X[:, j], s)[0, 1] for j in c])
        if cj.mean() < 0: w, s, cj = -w, -s, -cj
        keep = [i for i, r in enumerate(cj) if abs(r) >= 0.3]
        if len(keep) < 3: continue
        c = [c[i] for i in keep]; w = w[keep]; s = X[:, c] @ w
        ls = ll(s[:, None]); lms = {j: ll(X[:, j][:, None]) for j in c}
        if stats.chi2.sf(2 * (ls - l0), 1) >= 0.1 / len(comps): continue
        jm = max(lms, key=lms.get)
        if ls > lms[jm] - 4: mod, load, smod = c, {ids[j]: float(w[i]) for i, j in enumerate(c)}, s
        else: solo = jm
        break
    Xe = np.column_stack([X, smod]) if smod is not None else X
    sel = ([p] if mod else []) + ([solo] if solo is not None else []); cur = ll(cols(sel))
    if mod and ll(cols(sel + [jm])) - cur > 4: sel.append(jm); cur = ll(cols(sel))
    for k in range(MAX_DRIVERS):
        best = None
        for j in range(p):
            if j in sel or j in mod or any(abs(R[j, t]) >= 0.6 for t in sel if t < p): continue
            v = ll(cols(sel + [j]))
            if best is None or v > best[0]: best = (v, j)
        if best is None or stats.chi2.sf(2 * (best[0] - cur), 1) > 0.1 / p: break
        v, j = best
        clus = [j] + [c2 for c2 in range(p) if abs(R[j, c2]) >= 0.6 and c2 not in sel and c2 not in mod and not any(abs(R[c2, t]) >= 0.6 for t in sel if t < p)]
        if len(clus) > 1:
            lls = {c2: ll(cols(sel + [c2])) for c2 in clus}
            near = [c2 for c2 in clus if lls[c2] >= v - 2]
            j = max(near, key=lambda c2: sum(R[c2, d] ** 2 for d in clus)); v = lls[j]
        sel.append(j); cur = v
    while True:
        drops = [j for j in sel if j != p and stats.chi2.sf(2 * (cur - ll(cols([t for t in sel if t != j]))), 1) > 0.05 / p]
        if not drops: break
        sel = [t for t in sel if t != drops[0]]; cur = ll(cols(sel))
    pairs = [(a, b) for a in range(p) for b in range(a, p)]
    Pc = X[:, [a for a, b in pairs]] * X[:, [b for a, b in pairs]]; Pc -= Pc.mean(0)
    sc = (Pc.T @ (y - y.mean())) ** 2 / (np.sum(Pc ** 2, 0) * y.mean() * (1 - y.mean()) + 1e-12)
    cand = []
    for i in np.argsort(-sc)[:15]:
        a, b = pairs[i]; mains = sorted(set(sel) | {a, b})
        pv = stats.chi2.sf(2 * (ll(cols(mains, [(a, b)])) - ll(cols(mains))), 1)
        if pv < 0.01 / len(pairs): cand.append((pv, a, b))
    prods = []
    for pv, a, b in sorted(cand):
        if len(prods) < 2 and not any({a, b} & {c, d} for c, d in prods): prods.append((a, b))
    msel = list(dict.fromkeys(list(sel) + [c2 for a, b in prods for c2 in (a, b) if c2 not in mod]))
    for c2 in list(msel):
        if c2 in sel: continue
        rest = [t for t in msel if t != c2]
        if stats.chi2.sf(2 * (ll(cols(msel, prods)) - ll(cols(rest, prods))), 1) > 0.01 / p: msel = rest
    drivers = [j for j in sel if j < p] + [c2 for a, b in prods for c2 in (a, b)] + sorted(mod, key=lambda j: -ll(X[:, j][:, None]))
    drivers = [j for j in dict.fromkeys(drivers) if j < p][:MAX_DRIVERS]
    return Design(drivers=tuple(ids[j] for j in drivers), columns=tuple(ids[j] for j in msel if j < p),
                  products=tuple((ids[a], ids[b]) for a, b in prods), loadings=load)
